w02q1.intro: Ten sentences. Some are about a moment that has finished. Some are about right now. Put each one where it belongs.

items.prompt: Was it before, or is it happening now?
items: It was sunny at nine o'clock.
He was asleep on the bus.
It was quiet in the library.
items.teach: Was and were point backwards. Is and are with …ing point at this exact second.

items.prompt: Which word tells you it is happening RIGHT NOW?
items.teach: Is and are belong to now. Was and were belong to before.

items.prompt: It ______ raining an hour ago, but it stopped.
Six more. These ones are harder — the time word comes last.
items: The sun is shining at the moment.
We were at the beach yesterday.

w02q2.intro: Units 15 and 16: percussion instruments, and the present continuous that goes with them.

items.teach: “Listen —” means it is happening now, so is + …ing.

items.prompt: Every Tuesday he ______ in the band.
items.teach: Every Tuesday is a habit, not this second.

items.answer: The children are shaking the maracas
He was playing the drums an hour ago

w02q3.intro: Six clips. In every one, something changed. The answers stay asleep until the end.

items.say: The band was playing outside, but it started to rain, so now they're playing in the hall.
items.prompt: Where is the band playing now?
items.teach: Outside was true first. The rain changed it.

items.say: I was playing the triangle last year, but this year I'm learning the drums.
items.prompt: What is she learning this year?

items.say: It was very noisy a minute ago, but everyone is quiet now because the music is starting.
My sister was going to play the cymbals, but she's got a cold, so I'm playing them instead.
items.teach: “Instead” is the turn. The plan changed at the very end of the sentence.

items.say: The concert was on Friday last year. This year it's on Saturday.
items.prompt: Which day is the concert this year?

items.say: It's not windy now, but it was windy this morning, so the flags are still untidy.
items.teach: The untidy flags are evidence of the past, not of now.

boss.intro: The Weather Wizard will not let you past until you mark the time correctly. He accepts nothing that mixes up this morning with now.

items.say: It was cloudy and cold when we got up, but the sun came out at lunchtime and now it's lovely.

items.prompt: Tell the Wizard about this morning.
Now tell him about right now.

items.say: Don't take your coat off — it's warm in here, but it's freezing outside.
items.teach: Two places in one sentence, not two times. The last one is the one asked about.

items.say: It rained every day last week. It hasn't rained once since Monday.
items.teach: Last week and this week are two different weeks. The second sentence is the one that answers.
